unit.why: A tale told by the Hasidic tsaddik R. Baruch: an old scholar who has died complains in the heavenly court that a young man who died early ranks above him, and God settles it with an exegesis; a midrashic parallel follows.

stories.start_quote: סיפר הה"ק רר״ב הנ״ל מעשה נורא
stories.summary_en: An aged scholar who also engaged in trade dies and protests in the heavenly court that a young man who died young, devoted only to Torah and prayer, sits higher than him; God answers with a reading of 'מקץ שנתים ימים' (a whole lifetime may count as only a few days), and the complaint ends. A parallel midrash from Kohelet Rabbah is cited.
